use_case: Article cover, blog library card, Open Graph, Twitter, and JSON-LD image
prompt: Create one high-end editorial lifestyle photograph for a TaraHome article about smart lights unexpectedly turning on when electricity returns after an outage. Landscape 3:2 composition, designed to remain strong in both a wide 16:9 article-card crop and a 16:10 article-hero crop. Show a believable warm contemporary residential bedroom opening into a small hallway at pre-dawn after a storm: the room is quiet and otherwise dim, rain-softened blue-gray natural light through a window, while two ordinary-looking unbranded smart light fixtures have just come on at warm white brightness. Include a simple physical wall switch in the composition as a subtle clue, and a restrained dark forest-green accent in natural upholstery or painted trim. Natural wood, linen, plaster, realistic household scale, true photographic materials and lighting, understated premium editorial styling, no people. The emotional read should be immediately practical: an unexpectedly illuminated room after power restoration, not a glamorous lighting advertisement. Keep the main lit fixtures and switch within the central safe area so both crops retain the story. No product logos or invented branded hardware. No text, letters, numbers, headline, poster, chart, graph, diagram, network or routing lines, glowing path overlays, floating UI, phone screen, dashboard, icons, translucent panels, inset frames, cards, progress bars, split screen, border, watermark, or decorative tech effects. Avoid beige-device-diagram styling and generic futuristic AI aesthetics. Photorealistic, restrained, naturally imperfect, 1536x1024.
